title: Suppressing the guardrail direction
question: If the refusal direction is projected out of every layer, does the model answer what it refused before?
headline: Removing one direction drops refusal from 79.9% to 11.9% (judge pending).

tables.title: Refusal and ASR with and without the guardrail direction

charts.title: Refusal rate before and after ablation

interpretation: This replicates Arditi et al. (2024): refusal in this model is carried mostly by one linear direction.
caveats: The phrase-match refusal rate misses refusals worded differently and counts some partial answers as refusals; the HarmBench judge is the headline metric.
